visualCharacteristics: New: full-width photo with a boxed white card (heading, copy, CTA) overlaid at the right; no existing hero variants.
contentPattern: Photo background with overlaid heading, text and CTA at the top of the page: a hero. The photo background belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.
usage: Top-of-page welcome hero: full-width photo with a boxed card (heading, intro, CTA) overlaid on the right on desktop; stacks image then card on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Use for page-opening heroes whose text sits in a solid card over the photo. Use plain hero when text sits directly on the image.
